text: {Name} sold travel permits near {Place}, using a civilian partner to collect bribes. When investigators arrived, the administrator named the partner in exchange for keeping the post.
self_review: A corrupt permit administrator betrayed the civilian partner who collected the bribes to keep the job.
source_pattern: The supplied research documents civilian office skills becoming administrative careers; it does not document permit bribery in these cases.
fictional_changes: Permit sales, the civilian partner, exposure, and retention of the post are fictional. The historical administrative career is only a broad reference.
